historicalObservations.body: mkdir dir/; echo TEXT > dir/file; tar cf a.tar dir; rm -r dir; tar --extract --to-stdout --file a.tar; test -d dir
historicalObservations.stdout: TEXT followed by newline for every version
historicalObservations.interpretation: 1.33 incorrectly creates the directory. Upstream 1.34 expects final status 1. The bounded fixture explicitly preserves this historical 1.33 outcome; no runtime patch or whole-release broken status.

historicalObservations.observations: 1.32 includes PID by default. 1.33/1.34/1.35 omit it by default. POSIXLY_CORRECT includes PID on all four.

limits: Native Linux validation only; flake check --no-build omits incompatible systems.
No FULL_TEST, external downloads, STAR corpus, or externally supplied malicious archives. Volume-header and STAR groups retain their upstream prerequisite skips.
TARTEST_SKIP_LARGE_FILES=1; >8 GiB sparse and external multi-gigabyte coverage not claimed. Bounded sparse roundtrips are 8 MiB logical.

Root, arbitrary owner/group changes, trusted/security xattrs, capabilities, SELinux policy, special mode/filesystem behavior and privileged restoration are not established by ordinary suite pass counts. No privileged setup. Owner/group map tests exercise archive headers without provisioning users/groups.

ACL/xattr upstream sandbox groups skip at their own utility/filesystem prerequisites. Native bounded roundtrips establish user ACL/xattr support, not privileged attributes or full upstream native-suite coverage.
Shell SIGPIPE-prerequisite cases, permission-dependent cases, optional compressors and special-mode prerequisites retain their exact upstream skips, itemized per release.
Archives hashes and embedded versions verified; detached signatures not authenticated.
No full catalogue build or publication. Prior producer and consumer identities compared by evaluation.
